entries.a501d5092945971c: A single-segment business that plans and sells furniture, fabric and other items, as well as interior and miscellaneous goods. Net sales for the fiscal year ended January 2026 were ¥12,159 million, and the number of stores as of January 31, 2026 was 48. Almost all furniture, fabric and other products are planned and developed in-house, and are sold under the two brands "unico" and "unico loom" through directly operated stores nationwide, an online shop and the corporate development department. Manufacturing is outsourced to cooperating factories in Japan and overseas.
